comments.author: BetterNeil
comments.text: Sagi Haviv says a good logo needs to be 3 things: 1. Appropriate [like a feeling or personality that fits an industry], 2. Distinctive/memorable and 3. Super simple (the most important of the 3 things). A bad logo is: 1. Too complicated 2. Generic.
